main_entity: Name of the {entity} stated in the document
jurisdiction: Where the {entity} is officially registered, if present. It can be a country, state or territory, like Delaware or British Columbia.
relation_name: Name of the person or company related to the main {entity}
relation_address: Address of the person or company related to the main {entity}, if present. This field should include the literal address captured in the document, including c/o field if present.
relation_country: Country of the address of the person or company related to the main {entity}, if present
relation_nationality: Nationality of the person related to the main {entity}, if present
relation_type: Type of related entity. Must be one of these two: ['Person', 'Company']. Cannot be null. If it's not clear, use your best judgement based on the name and context.
relationship: Relationship of the related entity to the main {entity}, i.e. what relation_name is to main_entity. {relationship_choice}
NOTES: Any other relevant information not captured in the fields above
